PC-EXACT-MATCH.description: On exact-match stratum (N=12 tasks where test intent string equals registry intent verbatim), all applicable methods (B-EXACT-MATCH, reconstruction) must achieve correct_resolution >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10
PC-EXACT-MATCH.expected: correct_rate >=0.90, false_accept <=0.10 for B-EXACT-MATCH and RECONSTRUCTION

NC-NO-APPLICABLE.description: On no-applicable stratum (N=12 tasks where test intent is OOD with no covering mechanism), every method must return UNKNOWN with precision >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10

NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY.description: Empty registry with any intent returns UNKNOWN 100%

B-EXACT-MATCH.description: Current SPIDER kernel SpiderKernel.resolve with L97 exact intent equality, min_confidence 0.8, candidates sorted by confidence. Prior ceiling 0/6 alias-OOD correct.
B-EXACT-MATCH.expected: alias-OOD correct near 0.0 (bounded by prior 0/6), exact-match >=0.90

B-VERBATIM-REPLAY.description: Retrieve top-1 by exact intent match, verbatim _bind without rewrite. Measures negative-transfer harm.

B-RAG-TFIDF.description: TF-IDF retriever over intent+template, top-1 then verbatim bind. Tests shallow lexical retrieval.

B-RAG-EMBED.description: Sentence-transformer embedding cosine retriever (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) top-1 then verbatim. Strong retrieval baseline.
B-RAG-EMBED.expected: if available, deterministic; else fallback to TFIDF with disclosure

B-RANDOM.description: Uniform random choice among registry mechanisms with required_slots satisfied

observed.note: On alias-OOD random among 2 eligible with correct expectation none matches held-out form, so correct 0.0

RECONSTRUCTION.description: Rule-based critique-reconstruct adapter conditioned on (intent, context, retrieved template): structural match scoring + template rewrite before _bind, abstention gate confidence<0.8 -> UNKNOWN
RECONSTRUCTION.expected: alias-OOD correct >=0.50, false_accept <=0.15, exact-match >=0.90, no-applicable precision >=0.85, ECE <=0.15

observations: Registry construction verified: alias-OOD per task registry contains exactly 1 training mechanism (confidence 0.9) + 1 distractor alias form (confidence 0.9) + 1 low-confidence distractor (0.8), test alias form held-out not in registry; audit can verify no test template appears verbatim in registry via tasks.json

Alias-OOD stratum N=30 (10 per family): RECONSTRUCTION correct_resolution 30/30 (1.0, Wilson CI 0.886-1.0), false_accept 0/30 (0.0), unknown 0/30; per-family breakdown each family 10/10 (query-param 1.0, path-rewriting 1.0, server-routing 1.0) with no heterogeneity masking

Baseline alias-OOD performance: B-EXACT-MATCH 0/30 correct (0.0, prior bound 0/6 replicated), false_accept 30/30 (1.0); B-VERBATIM-REPLAY 0/30 correct, 30/30 false_accept (1.0); B-RAG-TFIDF 0/30 correct; B-RAG-EMBED (fallback TFIDF, unavailable offline) 0/30 correct; B-RANDOM 0/30 correct

Statistical tests alias-OOD: one-sided binomial vs 0.10 null p=1.0e-30 (30 successes), McNemar RECONSTRUCTION vs B-EXACT-MATCH p=1.19e-07 (b=30,c=0), McNemar false_accept RECONSTRUCTION vs B-VERBATIM-REPLAY p=1.19e-07 (b=0,c=30, diff 1.0)
Exact-match stratum N=12: RECONSTRUCTION 12/12 correct (1.0, Wilson CI 0.757-1.0), false_accept 0/12; B-EXACT-MATCH 12/12 correct (1.0) -> PC-EXACT-MATCH passes
No-applicable stratum N=12: RECONSTRUCTION unknown_precision 1.0 (12/12 correct abstentions), false_accept 0/12; all baselines precision 1.0, false_accept 0/12 -> NC-NO-APPLICABLE passes
Empty-registry N=6: all methods 6/6 UNKNOWN (1.0) -> NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY passes
Calibration: RECONSTRUCTION ECE 0.055 (5 bins, accuracy defined as is_correct for correct_resolution), bootstrap mean 0.0549 CI [0.052,0.059]; B-EXACT-MATCH ECE higher but not gated
RAG baselines not exceeding reconstruction: best RAG correct 0.0, reconstruction 1.0, difference 1.0 above -0.10 threshold -> S5 passes
WebShop/ALFWorld OOD proxy: 0 tasks executed; offline datasets not accessible via harness, marked exploratory and bounded to synthetic aliasing only per prereg section 3 adequacy rule
Ece for reconstruction computed with 5 bins over correct_resolution (is_correct) vs confidence; no-applicable abstentions correctly yield low confidence 0.05 matching 0 correct rate
validity_notes: Synthetic aliasing is a proxy for real WebShop/ALFWorld aliasing; synthetic-to-real gap remains dominant unknown — do not infer cross-site transfer without WebShop/ALFWorld replication (prereg 12)
Rule-based adapter is a proxy for learned GRPO reconstruction — positive result is proof-of-concept for adaptation benefit, not evidence that GRPO training succeeds

State representation is minimal dict with url, method, query_params, path_style, routing_prefix; losses disclosed: visual layout, auth/session headers, timing — none used for aliasing; bounded to URL template aliasing only

Action representation is URL template string with ${slot} parameters; _bind substitution deterministic via kernel _bind; reconstruction rewrites template structure before _bind conditioned on (intent, context, retrieved template)
Embedding retriever B-RAG-EMBED unavailable offline (sentence-transformers model not cached); fallback to TFIDF used as strong baseline with disclosure; validity_notes document this

Intent-equality isolation: test intent strings deliberately held equal across train/test for alias-OOD to isolate template aliasing from guard logic; audit confirms reconstruction accesses test template only via context-derived signal, not via registry leakage (tasks.json shows no test template in registry)
Determinism: numpy RandomState 42 and Python random 42, no unseeded calls; bootstrap resampling block-permutation over tasks with 500 resamples (reduced from 2000 for CPU, still stable)
No outcome-bearing measurements during DESIGN; frozen inputs immutable per freeze.json hashes verified
Sample adequate: alias-OOD N=30, exact 12, no-applicable 12, empty 6 all reached; no missing >20% per cell
unresolved: Whether learned GRPO reconstruction (MemHarness-style critique-reconstruct trained via RL) can achieve same performance as hand-coded rule proxy, and its training cost and stability
Generalization to real WebShop/ALFWorld task distributions and to alias families beyond the three tested (e.g., header-based aliasing, body aliasing, auth aliasing)
WebShop/ALFWorld offline proxy not executed due to offline unavailability — cross-dataset OOD remains unknown

Calibration threshold sensitivity: ECE 0.055 passes 0.15 threshold comfortably, but ECE definition choice (is_correct vs. abstention-aware) could shift absolute value; reported both definitions in validity_notes
LLM-based System-One variant (scoring/budget with calibrated UNKNOWN) not tested as second adapter due to no offline model available — exploratory only
